findings.passage: You have a responsibility if you want to vote to vote however it's going to happen.
findings.note: Quoted by The Kansas City Star (via Yahoo) on his bill to end the three-day mail-ballot grace period after Election Day; he says voters have options and a duty to get their vote in on time.

findings.passage: You'd have to be completely isolated and cut off from society not to be able to get your vote in.
findings.note: Quoted by The Kansas City Star (via Yahoo) on why the mail-ballot grace period is not needed.

findings.passage: We don't want to be a trainwreck on national TV like some other states.
findings.note: Quoted by the Lawrence Times on why he chairs hearings of the special committee on elections; he stresses keeping Kansas elections secure.
